lines.en: ...Confess... and rest.
I swear I didn't do it, sir.
I was home... my mother will swear to it.

lines.ar: گلتلك كلشي أستاذ... شنو بعد أگول؟
lines.en: I told you everything, sir... what else is there?
Sir, how long have I been here?
An hour? Two?... I've lost track of time.
Let me sleep a bit and I'll talk. I swear.
What time is it, sir?

lines.ar: الصايغ؟ أعرفه من بعيد... عمري ما دخلت دكانه.
lines.en: The goldsmith? I knew him by sight... I never set foot in his shop.
...Who is it?

lines.ar: ماي... بس شوية ماي. حلگي ناشف.
lines.en: Water... just a little water. My throat's dry.

lines.ar: أمي... أمي ما تدري وين أني.
lines.en: My mother... my mother doesn't know where I am.

lines.ar: لا تنطيني چاي بعد أستاذ. الچاي ما يخليني أنام.
lines.en: No more tea, sir. The tea won't let me sleep.

lines.ar: ليلة جابوني... تركوني بالسيارة وحدي. ساعة كاملة. وچنت أسمع شي يمشي بالقصب... ويوگف لما أوگف.
lines.en: The night they brought me in... they left me alone in the car. A whole hour. Something was walking in the reeds... it stopped when I stopped.
Sir... the light hurts my eyes.
Muffled. Repeat: muffled.
Received.

lines.ar: أني بس قريت الخطوط. الخط المكتوم يعني ناس... بس قريتها.
lines.en: I only read the lines. A muffled line means people... I only read it.

lines.ar: أني شغّلت السماعة بس. ما سمعت شي... ما سمعت.
lines.en: I only ran the speaker. I heard nothing... nothing.

lines.ar: المضخات ما تسأل منو بالقصب... أني بس شغّلتها.
lines.en: Pumps don't ask who's in the reeds... I only ran them.

lines.ar: أني بلّغت الإحداثيات... بس الأرقام، بس—
lines.en: I reported the coordinates... only numbers, only—
Next pulse... five forty-seven.

lines.ar: زين... زين أستاذ. أني سويتها. بس خليني أنام.
lines.en: Okay... okay, sir. I did it. Just let me sleep.
You're back, sir?

lines.ar: ...المحطة سبعة... المحطة سبعة، ماكو جواب. أعيد...
lines.en: ...Station Seven... Station Seven, no answer. Repeat...

lines.ar: ...جثة عريف بصريفة مهجورة... ساعته واقفة على خمسة وسبعة وأربعين...
lines.en: ...a corporal's body in an abandoned reed hut... his watch stopped at five forty-seven...

lines.ar: هنا البرج ثلاثة... الصدى... مـ... مكتوم.
lines.en: Tower three here... the echo... m-... muffled.

lines.ar: كل المحطات... تحوّل للقناة أربعة... أربعة.
lines.en: All stations... switch to channel four... four.
The chart shows... northern line, muffled.
Speaker three fired. Echo... muffled.

lines.ar: وصلني مكتوم. المضخات تشتغل لحد الصبح.
lines.en: Got 'muffled'. Pumps run till morning.
...southern bearing... muffled.
Where were you, sir?
A whole hour I've been looking for you.

lines.ar: چـ... چنت... چنت تصيّح. سمعتك من بعيد.
lines.en: You were... you were screaming. I heard you from far off.
Tantal.
The battery, sir.
This... is yours, sir.
Testing... one, two, three.
...e's in the corridor with you.
Don't open for him, sir.
[m u f f l e d]
[...the river.]
Testing... one, two, three.
